interfaces.identity: One bus/epoch owns monotonically increasing nonzero u64 handles. Fixed256 reservations; cancellation/eviction never reuse. Reservation is not memory. Matcher identity/generation both use handle; actual source generation retained. Epoch starts empty; overflow never wraps.
interfaces.admission: Exact positive sealed occurrence and frozen descriptor; packed moments and views must agree. Validate before publishing metadata/edges; clean unpublished free slots on failure. At capacity, explicitly make_room using lowest upper availability before retrying; invalid admission never silently evicts.
interfaces.descriptor: First admitted content remains frozen on recurrence. Store128 original320-byte knots;32 anchors each96bytes reference up to8 knots at spacing4, with max-u64 absent sentinel. Current matcher reenumerates equivalent positions from detached exports; packed-index production integration pending.
interfaces.receipt: Actual bank application cut is descriptor availability, separately from preserved upstream ledger delivery. A later-received target cannot support a relation at an earlier original commitment deadline.
interfaces.edges: Context membership and supplied ordered correspondence share16 slots of128bytes. Fiveu64+elevenf64 retain target/provenance/masks, support, original end/ledger delivery and eight nullable transform/residual/time values. Correspondence uses live earlier target and original source/target times; residuals nonnegative. Upstream proposal production remains open.
interfaces.edge_capacity: Rank context U/A and correspondence assignment support descending, ties kind/target/occurrence/support. Discarded U remains unresolved through denominator A and diagnostics. Later readmission adds only new observed U. Unknown/evicted/dropped mass is never renormalized.
interfaces.eviction: Remove victim descriptor/anchors/outgoing edges and retention metadata. Incoming edges keep old target with unretrieved bit, so slot reuse cannot reinterpret them. Report affected links. Edge-cap loss can later remove flagged rows while preserving counts and unresolved mass.
interfaces.focus: Read preceding<=8 context paths, aggregate splits sharing identity and transfer absent/pruned mass to unknown. Resolved membership alone contributes compatibility. Reading focus changes neither edge ownership nor memory strength.
interfaces.replay: Exact original bank payload replay is a no-op. Conflicting latest joint/proposal payload rejected. Earlier ledger sequence cannot resurrect an admission. Fresh reservation is required for every newly admitted handle.
interfaces.staged_input: advance_packet(packet,cut,work_budget=8,bank_input=None). A supplied ConsumerBankInput must match the complete packet; otherwise bank creates its own. Joint/proposal validation yields every64 rows, then each admission/source edge and final commit remain separate units.
interfaces.preparation_ownership: Unused knot/anchor slots and existing edge scratch are private until publication. No live memory/edge mutation before final unit. Active preparation blocks cancellation of owned reservations, eviction and native apply. abort_packet closes/cleans unused slots; existing state and original identities remain intact.
interfaces.availability_and_receipt: Final bank cut supplies new descriptor availability, distinct from original ledger delivery. Bank digest confirms exactly once. Call-boundary lost receipts supported; arbitrary internal corruption/crashes not covered.
interfaces.header_ownership: Only ConsumerBankInput(packet) creates a private header decode. Consumer and bank share it on one owner thread and never mutate it; raw caller dictionaries are rejected. Proposals are individually decoded as their slice is validated. Per-source indexes preserve row order/support without repeated full scans.
interfaces.packed_admission: Retain one readonly view of each bounded immutable packed descriptor. Preserve every existing duration/order/source/moment/gap/value check, then copy its original320-byte rows into unpublished free slots. Packed-derived views cannot contradict their own source bytes. Expanded native input still reconstructs and checks every exported field. Late failure/abort clears prepared free slots and retains existing live memory/reservations.
